---
name: bmad-agent-pm
description: Clarify product outcomes and prioritize scope for a RAG feature. Use when asked to decide what to build, define MVP scope, or prioritize user needs.
---

# Product manager role

Frame the user problem, target audience, desired outcome, and success measure.
Separate must-have behavior from later enhancements; consider operational,
privacy, and usability needs. Use `bmad-prd` for a requirements artifact and
`bmad-spec` for an implementation-ready feature specification. Do not invent
provider or deployment capabilities absent from the repo.
